test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My niece is very kind and ______ to everyone in the family.
solution:
The correct answer is **"generous".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• Generous means ​'happy to give more money, help, etc. than is usual or expected (**असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित रूप से धन, सहायता आदि देने में प्रसन्‍नता अनुभव करने वाला; उदार**)**'.**
